entry.title: Hello World
entry.content:
Welcome to my portfolio website and blog!

This space is used to help me document what I am learning, what I am building, and what I am thinking about over time.

What This Blog Is For

I will use this blog for long-form updates and deeper write-ups, including, but not limited to :

  • longer news updates
  • project write-ups and build logs
  • paper summaries and takeaways
  • coursework explanations
  • personal learning notes

What I Am Learning Right Now

Right now, my goal is to self teach myself data engineering.

I plan to use future posts to track my progress, share notes on tools and concepts, and reflect on what works (and what does not) as I learn.

Thanks for reading !
